scenes.title: A Comeback Home Run
scenes.summary: With trade tensions on television, Toshi hires an inexpensive local coordinator in Hawaii, Kawada supplies emergency funds one last time, and Toshi sends Muranishi's crew off demanding a comeback hit.

scenes.title: Opening credits and flight to Hawaii
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence and flight across the Pacific to Honolulu.

scenes.title: Landing on the Island
scenes.summary: Landing under sunny island skies, the crew meets their cheerful local coordinator, loads the heavy camera gear into his van, and wonders why he knows old Japanese songs by heart.

scenes.title: A Villa and the Local Cast
scenes.summary: At a rented hillside villa, the coordinator admits he is actually from Tokyo without a residency card, and Muranishi pitches his grand spy movie before questioning the quality of the local cast.

scenes.title: Mistaken Identity and Borrowed Cash
scenes.summary: Wearing dark director sunglasses, Muranishi mistakes the star actress's manager for the star herself, while back in Tokyo Toshi asks Kawada where he really borrowed the production funds.

scenes.title: Tea With Ikezawa
scenes.summary: Over tea in Tokyo, industry boss Ikezawa asks Kuroki about her mother and whether she plans to continue acting, while Kawada and Toshi laugh over how Muranishi bluffed an overseas star.

scenes.title: No Compromises
scenes.summary: Meeting the foreign lead actress through his interpreter, Muranishi declares he will not compromise on his vision to shock the world and insists that true cinema depends on subtlety.

scenes.title: Asking Furuya for Help
scenes.summary: In Tokyo, Toshi tells yakuza boss Furuya about Muranishi's overseas gamble and asks for help against their rivals, prompting Furuya to offer one risky way to beat Ikezawa.

scenes.title: Trouble on the Street Shoot
scenes.summary: Muranishi directs an outdoor street scene without a permit until the actors rebel and local police question the crew, forcing Muranishi to wrap up and rewrite the script on the move.

scenes.title: Facing the Actress Eye to Eye
scenes.summary: Urged by his makeup artist to listen to his lead actress the way he listened to Kuroki, Muranishi speaks from the heart about respecting her work and wins a committed performance on set.

scenes.title: Above Ground and Underground
scenes.summary: Furuya shows Toshi a hidden tape factory and explains how underground sales dwarf retail numbers, while Detective Takei raids Fujiwara's plant and Furuya asks if Toshi wants to surpass Ikezawa.

scenes.title: Detective Takei's Butterfly Collection
scenes.summary: During the warehouse raid, Detective Takei compares busting illegal syndicates to mounting butterfly specimens, explaining that he waits until a target grows large before striking.

scenes.title: Into the Sky
scenes.summary: At a small airfield, Muranishi announces plans to shoot world-first aerial footage from a plane; despite her manager's alarm, the lead actress agrees and the crew prepares for the final scene.

scenes.title: Wrapping the Final Scene
scenes.summary: In Tokyo, Kuroki declines her fee for the unreleased tape and tells Kawada she has started modelling to study in Italy, just as Muranishi wraps his aerial climax in triumph.

scenes.title: A Toast and a Call From Kuroki
scenes.summary: Celebrating at the wrap party, the crew thanks their coordinator for saving the shoot, and Kuroki phones Muranishi's hotel room right before the lead actress comes to say goodbye.

scenes.title: Three Hundred Seventy Years
scenes.summary: After a blunt parting from the lead actress, federal agents tipped off by the coordinator raid the hotel and arrest Muranishi, who quips to reporters about rumors of a 370-year sentence.

scenes.title: Closing credits
scenes.summary: Closing credits music over the aftermath of Muranishi's arrest.
